menu.applications.outcome: The standard launcher action opens the selected launcher's native desktop-application list and starts the chosen entry; Super+Space keeps opening the same catalog command.

menu.commands.outcome: A separate action opens the launcher's native executable search and starts the chosen PATH executable.

menu.choose.outcome: menu_choose.sh shows sanitized, collision-free labels through the launcher's dmenu mode and prints exactly one offered record ID (exit 0), or exits 3 on cancel, 1 on launcher failure or unoffered output, 2 on an invalid request.

menu.confirm.outcome: menu_choose.sh --confirm offers No first and Yes second and exits 0 only when Yes is selected; cancel, No, typed text or launcher errors never confirm.

launcher/wofi.summary: Applications (drun), command search (run), shared chooser and Catppuccin theme all work natively.
limitations: Wofi reports both Escape and internal errors with exit status 1, so a crashed chooser is reported as cancelled.
launcher/wofi.data_boundary: Wofi keeps its own drun/run usage caches under ~/.cache; chooser labels are never cached (cache file /dev/null) or logged; nothing is migrated.

menu.applications.note: wofi --show drun honors NoDisplay, Hidden, TryExec, OnlyShowIn and desktop-ID shadowing.

menu.commands.note: wofi --show run with the catalog style.

menu.choose.note: Text output with exact label matching; markup and image escapes forced off; no_custom_entry and print_line_num are not used because they select or print the wrong row for typed text.

theme.note: Rendered region in the shipped menu.css (GTK 3 discards the whole stylesheet when an @import target is missing, E-D02-019); verified in both variants (E-D02-020).

launcher/rofi.summary: Applications (drun), command search (run), shared chooser by index and a generated rasi theme are native rofi features.
limitations: Rofi reports both Escape and internal errors with exit status 1, so a crashed chooser is reported as cancelled.
The verified rofi 1.7.5 build is X11-only and runs through Xwayland; keyboard behavior is checked in the VM.
launcher/rofi.data_boundary: Rofi keeps its own drun/run history caches under ~/.cache; the chooser uses dmenu mode, which keeps no history; nothing is migrated.

menu.applications.note: rofi -show drun; real desktop-entry filtering is checked in the VM.

menu.choose.note: -format i -no-custom -no-markup-rows: 0-based index output, custom entries refused natively.

theme.note: Generated theme loaded with @theme by absolute path from a managed region of config.rasi; parsed by rofi -dump-theme in both variants (E-D02-010).

launcher/fuzzel.summary: Applications, command search with PATH executables, chooser by index and include-based theme are native fuzzel features.
limitations: Fuzzel has no executables-only mode: command search lists PATH executables together with applications.
Fuzzel shows entries restricted with OnlyShowIn to other desktops unless filter-desktop is enabled in its own configuration.
launcher/fuzzel.data_boundary: Fuzzel keeps its application launch counts in ~/.cache/fuzzel; chooser entries are not cached (cache /dev/null); nothing is migrated.

menu.applications.note: Default fuzzel mode hides NoDisplay, Hidden and failing TryExec entries and applies desktop-ID shadowing.

menu.commands.note: fuzzel --list-executables-in-path adds PATH executables to the application list (no separate executables-only list).

menu.choose.note: --index --only-match; Escape exits 2, which is mapped to cancelled.

theme.note: include= of a generated file from a managed region at the top of fuzzel.ini; fuzzel --check-config accepts both variants (E-D02-014).

launcher/bemenu.summary: Command search (bemenu-run), shared chooser and native color options work; Bemenu has no desktop-application mode.
limitations: Bemenu has no native desktop-application mode: the Applications action explains this and opens nothing; Super+Space keeps opening bemenu-run (executable search).
Bemenu cannot refuse typed text and reports Escape and errors with the same exit status; the chooser rejects unoffered text and treats status 1 as cancelled.
launcher/bemenu.data_boundary: Bemenu keeps no history; nothing is migrated.

menu.applications.note: bemenu(1) documents only dmenu input and bemenu-run over PATH executables; no desktop-entry mode exists and none is emulated.

menu.commands.note: bemenu-run with the Wayland backend (catalog command).

menu.choose.note: Text output with exact label matching; typed text is rejected as unoffered.

theme.note: Native --fn and color options from a generated file exported as BEMENU_OPTS by menu_exec.sh unless the user set BEMENU_OPTS (E-D02-017).

launcher/tofi.summary: Documented upstream: applications (tofi-drun), command search (tofi-run), chooser and include-based theme; not testable locally.
limitations: tofi is an AUR package that was not available in the test environment; its behavior is verified only from upstream documentation until the VM check.
tofi-run only prints the chosen executable; the command action starts exactly that PATH executable without arguments.
launcher/tofi.data_boundary: tofi-run and tofi-drun keep usage counts in ~/.local/state (tofi-history, tofi-drun-history); dmenu mode keeps none; nothing is migrated.

menu.commands.note: tofi-run --require-match=true prints the executable; the provider starts it as one argv element after resolving it on PATH.

theme.note: include of a generated file from a managed region of ~/.config/tofi/config; syntax from upstream tofi(5) and doc/config, not executed.

E-D02-001.environment: Arch Linux ARM aarch64 research chroot
E-D02-001.command: wofi --help; man wofi; man 5 wofi; man 7 wofi
E-D02-001.result: Modes run, drun, dmenu; --prompt, --define KEY=VALUE, --cache-file; config keys allow_markup and allow_images (default false), dmenu-print_line_num and dmenu-parse_action; config and style files layer /usr/etc, /etc, then XDG_CONFIG_HOME; 'set the cache file to /dev/null to effectively disable it'.

E-D02-002.source: wofi 1.5.3 dmenu mode driven with wtype
E-D02-002.environment: Arch Linux ARM aarch64 research chroot, headless sway 1.12 (pixman), private D-Bus session, wtype virtual keyboard
E-D02-002.command: printf 'alpha\nbeta\n' | wofi --dmenu --prompt Pick; keys Escape | 'beta' Return | 'zzz' Return | Return with empty stdin
E-D02-002.result: Escape: exit 1, no output. Typed beta + Return: prints 'beta', exit 0. Typed zzz + Return: prints 'zzz' (custom entry), exit 0. Empty stdin + Return: exit 0 with no output.

E-D02-003.environment: Arch Linux ARM aarch64 research chroot, headless sway 1.12, wtype
E-D02-003.command: wofi --dmenu -D no_custom_entry=true (with and without -D dmenu-print_line_num=true); keys 'zzz' Return
E-D02-003.result: With no matching row, Return returned the first row ('alpha' / index 0) instead of nothing, so no_custom_entry is not safe for identity selection.

E-D02-004.environment: Arch Linux ARM aarch64 research chroot, headless sway 1.12, wtype
E-D02-004.command: wofi --dmenu -D dmenu-print_line_num=true; keys Down Down Return | 'zzz' Return
E-D02-004.result: Third row printed '2' (0-based); typed custom text was printed verbatim ('zzz'), so a typed number would be indistinguishable from an index: index output is not used for wofi.

E-D02-005.source: wofi 1.5.3 screenshots (grim) with a config enabling allow_markup and allow_images
E-D02-005.environment: Arch Linux ARM aarch64 research chroot, headless sway 1.12, grim
E-D02-005.command: wofi --conf (allow_markup=true, allow_images=true) --dmenu < rows with bold and img:/usr/share/icons/...:text:imgtxt; again with --define=allow_markup=false --define=allow_images=false
E-D02-005.result: Without overrides the row rendered bold markup and an image; with the --define overrides both rows were shown literally, proving command-line defines override the shipped config.

E-D02-006.source: wofi 1.5.3 drun and run modes with synthetic desktop entries
E-D02-006.environment: Arch Linux ARM aarch64 research chroot, headless sway 1.12, wtype, grim; XDG_DATA_HOME and XDG_DATA_DIRS fixture directories
E-D02-006.command: wofi --show drun --cache-file /dev/null (type Hss; select HssVisible; select HssShadow); wofi --show run --search grim
E-D02-006.result: Listed HssVisible, HssTerm, HssLocEnglish and HssShadowUser; hid NoDisplay=true, Hidden=true, missing TryExec and OnlyShowIn=KDE entries; the user entry shadowed the system entry with the same desktop ID; selecting entries ran their Exec lines; run mode listed the grim executable.

E-D02-007.environment: Arch Linux ARM aarch64 research chroot, headless sway 1.12
E-D02-007.result: Default dmenu runs created ~/.cache/wofi-dmenu with the selected rows; runs with --cache-file /dev/null left it untouched. The legacy menu_exec.sh --dmenu route therefore caches selections; the shared chooser does not.

E-D02-008.environment: Arch Linux ARM aarch64 research chroot
E-D02-008.command: man rofi-dmenu; man rofi; man rofi-theme
E-D02-008.result: Modes drun and run; dmenu -p, -format i (0..N-1), -no-custom (only return a selected item), -markup-rows off by default; boolean options are disabled with -no-<option>; return value 0 selected, 1 cancelled, 10-28 custom keys; @theme discards the current theme and loads a file by name or full path, @import adds one.

E-D02-009.environment: Arch Linux ARM aarch64 research chroot, headless sway 1.12 with Xwayland 24.1.14, grim
E-D02-009.result: The Arch Linux ARM rofi 1.7.5 build links only xcb (no Wayland backend) and rendered the dmenu window with the 'Pick:' prompt through Xwayland; wtype keystrokes did not reach the Xwayland window, so selection and Escape exit codes remain documentation-only here.

E-D02-010.source: rofi 1.7.5 configuration parsing of the generated theme
E-D02-010.environment: Arch Linux ARM aarch64 research chroot, headless sway 1.12 with Xwayland
E-D02-010.command: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=<rendered home> rofi -dump-theme (config.rasi region: @theme "<absolute generated path>/rofi/theme.rasi") for dark and light
E-D02-010.result: rofi resolved hss-bg to rgba(30,30,46,100%) for dark and rgba(239,241,245,100%) for light and font "Noto Sans 10" without parse errors.

E-D02-011.environment: Arch Linux ARM aarch64 research chroot
E-D02-011.result: --dmenu, --index (0-based, dmenu only), --only-match, --prompt, --cache (dmenu entries are cached only when --cache is given; /dev/null disables caching), --list-executables-in-path (application mode only), --check-config, --filter-desktop off by default, single-instance lock file.

E-D02-012.source: fuzzel 1.15.0 dmenu mode driven with wtype
E-D02-012.environment: Arch Linux ARM aarch64 research chroot, headless sway 1.12, wtype
E-D02-012.command: fuzzel --dmenu --prompt 'Pick: ' --cache /dev/null [--index --only-match]; keys Escape | Down Down Return | 'zzz' Return
E-D02-012.result: Escape exits 2 with no output; --index --only-match third row prints '2'; with --only-match typed non-matching text + Return keeps the menu open (Escape then exits 2); --index without --only-match prints -1 for typed text.

E-D02-013.source: fuzzel 1.15.0 application mode with synthetic desktop entries
E-D02-013.environment: Arch Linux ARM aarch64 research chroot, headless sway 1.12, wtype, grim; fixture XDG data directories, XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP=Hyprland
E-D02-013.command: fuzzel --cache /dev/null (type Hss; select HssVisible; select HssShadow); fuzzel --list-executables-in-path --search grim
E-D02-013.result: Hid NoDisplay, Hidden and missing-TryExec entries, showed the OnlyShowIn=KDE entry (no filter-desktop), user entry shadowed the system entry; selecting entries ran their Exec lines; --list-executables-in-path listed grim among applications.

E-D02-014.source: fuzzel 1.15.0 configuration check and rendering of the generated theme
E-D02-014.environment: Arch Linux ARM aarch64 research chroot, headless sway 1.12, grim
E-D02-014.command: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=<rendered home> fuzzel --check-config (fuzzel.ini region include=<absolute generated path>/fuzzel/theme.ini), dark and light; fuzzel --dmenu screenshot
E-D02-014.result: --check-config exit 0 for both variants; the dark screenshot shows Mocha background, Blue border, prompt and selection.

E-D02-015.environment: Arch Linux ARM aarch64 research chroot
E-D02-015.result: bemenu reads newline-separated items and prints selections; bemenu-run lists executables under PATH and executes the selection; no desktop-entry mode exists; -I only highlights an index (no index output); Shift+Return prints the filter text; exit 1 means the user exited without selecting or an error occurred; BEMENU_OPTS passes options; --fn, --tb ... --bdr and -B set font, colors and border.

E-D02-016.source: bemenu 0.6.23 Wayland backend driven with wtype
E-D02-016.environment: Arch Linux ARM aarch64 research chroot, headless sway 1.12, BEMENU_BACKEND=wayland, wtype
E-D02-016.command: bemenu -p Pick -l 10 < rows; keys Escape | Down Down Return | 'zzz' Return
E-D02-016.result: Escape exits 1 with no output; the third row printed 'beta'; typed 'zzz' + Return printed 'zzz' with exit 0 (custom text cannot be refused natively).

E-D02-017.environment: Arch Linux ARM aarch64 research chroot, headless sway 1.12, grim
E-D02-017.command: BEMENU_OPTS="--fn 'Noto Sans 14' --tb '#1e1e2e' ... --bdr '#89b4fa' -B 2" bemenu -p Pick -l 10; then the rendered light bemenu.opts line
E-D02-017.result: bemenu parsed the single-quoted font name with spaces and applied colors and the border in both runs; the light screenshot shows Latte colors and a Blue highlight.

E-D02-018.source: tofi upstream documentation: doc/tofi.1.md, doc/tofi.5.md, doc/config and README.md at https://github.com/philj56/tofi (master; current release 0.9.1)
E-D02-018.environment: Web documentation; tofi is AUR-only and not installed in the test environment
E-D02-018.result: tofi reads stdin and prints the selection; tofi-run lists PATH executables and prints the selection (README: tofi-run | xargs swaymsg exec --); tofi-drun lists desktop entries and launches with --drun-launch=true; exit 0 selection, 1 error or no selection (Escape); --prompt-text, --require-match, --print-index (1-based), history files only for run/drun modes; 'include' inserts another config file; '#' comments; colors RGB/RGBA/RRGGBB/RRGGBBAA.

E-D02-019.environment: Arch Linux ARM aarch64 research chroot
E-D02-019.command: python3: Gtk.CssProvider().load_from_path() on stylesheets with @import before/after rules, redefined @define-color and a missing @import target; inspect parsing-error and to_string()
E-D02-019.result: @import is accepted after rules and @define-color; the last @define-color wins; a missing @import target raises an error and the provider keeps no rules at all, so wofi would lose its whole stylesheet. The wofi unit therefore renders its colors into a region of menu.css instead of importing a generated file.

E-D02-020.source: wofi 1.5.3 with the rendered menu.css region
E-D02-020.environment: Arch Linux ARM aarch64 research chroot, headless sway 1.12, grim
E-D02-020.command: hss_theme.py plan --variant dark|light --units wofi --adopt; wofi --dmenu --style <rendered menu.css>
E-D02-020.result: Dark shows Mocha base, surface0 input, Blue border and Blue selected row with base text; light shows Latte base and Blue accents; Noto Sans text; the dark render is byte-identical to the shipped region (planner reports unchanged).
